name: badge
description: A small inline label for a status or a count, tinted by a hue.

attributes.name: data-emphasis
attributes.description: medium is a subtle tint with dark text, high a solid fill, low text alone.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: The text size the badge sits beside; the badge renders one step smaller.

children.description: An optional icon, sized to the text.

tokens.name: --yeti-badge-radius
tokens.description: Corner radius; full makes a pill.

a11y.notes: A badge is text. If the colour carries meaning, the text must carry it too. A count that belongs to a control goes into that control's accessible name, not beside it.
